sourceToScriptMap.retain: Games are for enjoyment; gently lower the first-contact burden in competitive and solo games

sourceToScriptMap.retain: Dragging the newcomer through every decision removes interest and freedom

sourceToScriptMap.added: Show instructions disappear before actor selects path

sourceToScriptMap.retain: Initial interest is fragile; protect enjoyment and the next self-directed attempt

omittedNoninstructional: Personal win streak, current rustiness, identities of the arcade couple, and personal vow: nonessential biography, never claimed as ours.
KOF95 named move sequence: mechanism retained as attacks in succession; reference explicitly says not technically a combo, so it is not described as guaranteed combo damage.
Self-directed apology joke, creator intro/end cards: noninstructional, no reference creator framing or media used.

gameExamples.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
gameExamples.role: Different first-session goals; first corner feedback; Smart Steering and Auto-Accelerate
gameExamples.selectionReason: Existing verified FHD race and officially documented specific assists; newer Mario Kart World is not substituted merely for recency. Same necessary mechanics and known constraints preserved.
gameExamples.necessaryRules: Follow a course to finish; accelerate, steer, use items. Define drift then Mini-Turbo before third-stage constraint.
gameExamples.limits: General race recording does not prove assistance state, novice skill, emotions or a measured assist force.

gameExamples.title: Unpacking
gameExamples.role: Familiar action plus low physical input burden leaves personal placement choice
gameExamples.selectionReason: Cross-genre replacement of complex fighting inputs with a recognizable physical task and directly visible item placement; official no-hold/no-multiple-button/no-timer facts.
gameExamples.necessaryRules: Take possessions from boxes and find a place in each new room; can pick an item up again and rearrange.
gameExamples.limits: Removing input burden is not the same implementation as SF6 automatic attack selection. We retain the higher-level first-touch lesson, not a false one-to-one mechanics claim. Optional Allow items anywhere omitted as unnecessary; no imaginary settings screen.

gameExamples.title: A Short Hike
gameExamples.role: Self-selected path and discovery; know when to stop instructing
gameExamples.selectionReason: Retain the approved independent developer B-roll that directly shows walking/climbing/gliding.
gameExamples.necessaryRules: Move the bird, climb and glide toward visible places.
gameExamples.limits: Our marked routes are editorial possibilities, not measured player attention or AI-generated paths.
